detail: Contingency counts of new mathematical-sciences PhDs by institution type, gender and citizenship; 24 cells, a fixed-effects count/loglinear table, no grouping unit observations repeat within.

Experimenter-expectancy study: the grouping unit (the experimenter who collected each 18-rating batch) is not a column; the table holds only instruction, expectation and rating for a two-way between-subjects design.
43 US cities, cross-section; Fox fits OLS of moral integration on heterogeneity and mobility; region is a 4-level fixed covariate, not a documented random-effects grouping.
51 US states plus DC, one row per state; OLS of per-capita education spending on income, young and urban; no grouping factor.
5226 arrestees, one row each; logistic regression of release on race and covariates; no repeated grouping unit (year and checks are covariates).
1525 survey respondents, one row each; multinomial / proportional-odds logit of party choice; no grouping factor.
66 students in wide pre/post form; three-group ANCOVA/MANOVA with group a 3-level treatment; no grouping column (repeated measures only if the five score columns were reshaped long).
Help page states the IQ twin data were notoriously manufactured (fabricated), not real grouped observations.

2231-respondent survey stratified by province with design weights; the documented analysis is survey-weighted (design-based) logistic regression, province is a stratification/design variable rather than a documented random-effects grouping. RULE GAP: survey strata not treated as grouping factors.
2700-respondent national plebiscite survey; Fox fits logistic/multinomial of vote intention with region a 5-level fixed covariate; no documented random-effects grouping.
1421 respondents, one row each; logistic regression of volunteering on personality scales and sex; no grouping factor.
200 individuals, one row each; regression of reported on measured weight/height; sex a 2-level covariate; no grouping.
191 respondents in wide form with seven drive-for-thinness scale items to be summed; no grouping column and no single documented response/model.
434 Minnesota farms, one row each with longitude/latitude; spatial counts of wolf depredations; coordinates are not a grouping factor and no unit is repeated.
45 occupations, cross-section; OLS of occupational prestige on income and education; type a 3-level covariate; no grouping.
66 cities and state remainders, cross-section; regression of 1980 census undercount; city a 2-level covariate; no grouping.
67 counties, one row each with a vote-count column per candidate (wide); no grouping column and no documented mixed model.
110 US metropolitan areas, cross-section; regression of crime rate on population density and crowding; no grouping factor.
30 subjects, one row each; one-way between-subjects design (condition, 3 levels) on words recalled; no grouping column observations repeat within.

28867 GSS respondents; documented as a multifactor observational (fixed-effects factorial) study of vocabulary score, with year/ageGroup/educGroup/gender/nativeBorn as fixed factors; no respondent id and no documented random-effects grouping. RULE GAP: survey waves (year) not treated as a grouping factor.
20 four-person groups, one row per group; 2x2 between-groups design (condition, sex) on cooperative choices; the group is the observation unit, not a grouping factor observations repeat within.
Single annual Canadian crime-rate time series 1931-1968, one observation per year, no replication across units.
39 Minnesota highway segments, cross-section; regression of accident rate on design variables; htype a 4-level covariate; no grouping.
105 nations, cross-section; regression of infant mortality on income; region a 4-level fixed covariate, oil a 2-level covariate; no documented grouping.

Wide limit-of-blank/detection assay table: pool (12) by eight instrument-by-reagent-lot measurement columns, used only to illustrate Box-Cox-type transformations; no single documented response column and no documented model using pool as a grouping factor.
